slides.texte_overlay:
signs your brain needs a
reset (and how to give it one)

you forget why you walked in

you keep walking into rooms and forgetting why. a brain juggling too much needs fewer tabs open, so write things down on paper and finally let your memory rest.

small decisions feel huge

choosing what to eat or wear feels exhausting. that's decision fatigue, and simplifying your routine for a week gives your tired brain the room it needs to recover.

you can't finish a film

you check your phone every few minutes even during something you enjoy. a weekend without short videos is often enough to slowly bring your attention back.

learning feels heavy

when nothing new seems interesting, start tiny: 5 minutes a day on one lesson about a planet, a painting or a moment in history. small doses wake curiosity back up.

slides.texte_overlay:
you wake up tired

you sleep eight hours and still wake up drained. an hour without screens before bed and a fixed wake up time reset your sleep faster than anything else.
